title: Brown used ion-wind work to cover for electrogravitics

tellings.quote: And the funny thing is Brown himself would use the electrohydrodnamic stuff the the stuff involving ion wind to cover for the electrogravitics

plain: The inventor Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have used his work on ion wind, where charged particles push air and create thrust, as a cover for his real interest, electrogravitics, the idea that strong electric fields can make a force like gravity. Michels says this himself, without naming a source. If true, Brown's ordinary-sounding research was hiding a more radical claim.
